:::{#exm-contradiction}
#### $P \land \neg P$ is a contradiction
<!-- no-figure: the truth table is the display -->

By the definitions of [and](#def-and) and [not](#def-not),
the [truth table](#def-truth-table) of $P \land \neg P$ is:

| $P$ | $\neg P$ | $P \land \neg P$ |
|:---:|:--------:|:----------------:|
| T   | F        | F                |
| F   | T        | F                |

The last column is false in every row,
so $P \land \neg P$ is a [contradiction](#def-contradiction).

:::
